name: Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre
description: Terra, the missing daughter of Danaya, grows up in the human world, unaware of her true heritage. She takes on the role of a superhero before returning to Encantadia to confront a new enemy.

videos.title: The Queen of the Cursed
videos.overview: The Sang'gre sisters once faced a mighty beast in a forgotten chapter of their past. In the present, troubling visions and ancient warnings hint at dangers yet to come. As a dark force rises in a distant land, old legacies begin to stir once more.

videos.title: The New Savior
videos.overview: The queens of old prepare the next generation for a future that feels increasingly uncertain. As Cassiopea's visions grow more alarming, decisions are made that will change the fate of the realm. Meanwhile, a new power gathers strength in Mine-a-ve, with conquest set in motion.

videos.title: The Cursed One
videos.overview: A mysterious book unlocks long-buried secrets tied to the origins of Encantadia’s newest threat. As the truth about Mitena’s past slowly comes to light, her thirst for vengeance only grows deeper. While the forces of good falter under the weight of hidden knowledge, darkness prepares to breach the realm once more.

videos.title: Mitena's Enslavement in Mine-a-ve
videos.overview: Cassiopea’s search for answers leads only to more questions, as the secrets of the past remain tightly locked away. In Mine-a-ve, tensions rise between a daughter seeking strength and a mother clinging to safety. As Mitena’s harrowing history unfolds, a spark of hope emerges in an unexpected place.

videos.title: The Life that the Fairy Danaya Lived in the Human World
videos.overview: Life in the human world teaches Danaya harsh truths about greed, kindness, and the value of gold. When tragedy strikes without warning, her peaceful days shatter into grief and fury. As sorrow gives way to righteous rage, Danaya calls upon the earth itself to aid her in her quest for justice.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Fairies
videos.overview: Consumed by loss, Danaya hunts down those responsible and sets a solemn vow that only the worthy shall wield her husband’s blade. Her journey leads her to an unexpected bond with a grieving human whose kindness begins to restore her faith. As two wounded souls find solace in each other, a new spark of hope quietly ignites.

videos.title: Mitena's Power
videos.overview: A long-awaited birth brings new hope to Encantadia, even as shadows from the past rise with vengeance in their hearts. While Mitena’s dark ascent continues, old secrets finally come to light, shaking the foundations of the present. With danger on the horizon, the realms must unite or face a storm unlike any before.

videos.title: Farewell and Return
videos.overview: As the kingdoms brace for war, old alliances are rekindled, and new heirs step into the burdens of legacy. While personal doubts and heartfelt losses linger, the forces of darkness strike their first blow through deception. With the fate of Lireo hanging in the balance, the true battle for Encantadia begins.

videos.title: The Descent of Darkness in Encantadia
videos.overview: Chaos erupts across the kingdoms as Mitena launches her deadly assault. With stolen power and cunning deception, she claims both gems and lives in her quest for vengeance. As the Diwatas scramble to regroup, a desperate call is made for the only Sang’gre who may still turn the tide.

videos.title: The New Queen of Encantadia
videos.overview: As Encantadia reels from heavy losses, its defenders rally for one final stand against the rising tide of darkness. In the human world, Danaya faces treachery and heartbreak that reignite her fighting spirit. With armies aligned on both sides, the battle for the realm stands on the edge of eruption.

videos.title: Another War in Encantadia
videos.overview: The battle for Lireo erupts in full force, testing the courage and resolve of Encantadia’s warriors. As defeat looms and leaders fall, a desperate hope flickers in the face of overwhelming power. With gems lost and heroes imprisoned, darkness casts its longest shadow yet across the realm.

videos.title: The Meeting of Twins
videos.overview: Mitena tightens her grip on Encantadia, seeking to erase the legacies of the past. As Pirena makes a final stand, she is forced into exile, wounded and alone in the human world. Meanwhile, the last hopes of resistance now rest on a hidden child and the quiet prayers of those beyond the mortal realm.

videos.title: Memen and Mitena: Father and Daughter
videos.overview: As Encantadia falls deeper under Mitena’s control, hope quietly endures in the human world where Terra grows up unaware of her true identity. While her protectors struggle to shield her, strange signs begin to surface, revealing her unique bond with nature. But as danger draws closer, even a hidden life may not stay hidden for long.

videos.title: The Courage of the Young Terra
videos.overview: Danger creeps closer to Terra’s quiet life, triggering a strange force that shields her from harm. As questions about her past grow louder, she faces struggles that go beyond the ordinary. Beneath the surface, hidden enemies begin their search for the truth she has yet to discover.

videos.title: The Powerful Mentor of Terra
videos.overview: As strange truths begin to surface, Terra is drawn toward a destiny far greater than she imagined. Meanwhile, the remaining heirs of Encantadia attempt to challenge Mitena’s cruel reign, only to suffer painful losses. While the faithful await a long-promised awakening, one young soul begins her path toward something extraordinary.

videos.title: Terra and the Pashneas
videos.overview: Terra's bond with animals deepens when a dangerous incident at the zoo reveals a powerful new ability. But when a ruthless gang threatens the people she cares about, Terra learns that her gift has limits. In a world that won't stop taking, Terra begins to question how much she can give.

videos.title: The Secrecy of Imaw
videos.overview: Terra's powers lead to devastating consequences, forcing her to confront the cost of using them. Meanwhile, a bold sacrifice deceives Mitena and shields the last Sang'gres from discovery. As old heroes fall and new ones rise, hope flickers in secret corners of a kingdom under siege.

videos.title: Terra's Coming of Age
videos.overview: As Terra’s training intensifies under a mysterious mentor, hints of her true heritage begin to surface. In Encantadia, a young man begins to question who he truly is amid acts of quiet heroism. With Flamarra struggling to balance survival and secrecy, and Mitena drunk on power, the pieces of the prophecy quietly fall into place.

videos.title: Gifts of Gold
videos.overview: Terra’s bravery and combat skills inspire her community, but her rising power draws concern from both family and mentor. As her mentor prepares to leave, he hints at Terra’s greater destiny and the trials that await. Meanwhile, in Encantadia, signs begin to stir that the prophecy is nearing its fulfillment.

videos.title: Theft of the Pashneas
videos.overview: As Terra’s birthday approaches, she secretly turns to her powers to help her hungry neighbors. Emil and his men begin cracking down on the community. Meanwhile, Mitena receives a chilling vision that hints her reign may soon face a reckoning.

videos.title: On the Sang'gre's Birthday
videos.overview: As her eighteenth birthday arrives, Terra faces the consequences of her selfless act. In Encantadia, Mitena questions her invincibility after a dream and a troubling answer from the Rivulet of Truth. Across worlds, signs of a greater destiny begin to unfold.

videos.title: New Friends
videos.overview: On her eighteenth birthday, Terra discovers a strange new ability. While her friends and neighbors rally to secure her freedom, Emil secretly manipulates the system to keep her locked away. But when Terra returns home, she’s welcomed by voices she never thought she’d hear and a gift that may change her fate forever.

videos.title: The Concealment of Ability
videos.overview: Terra’s birthday celebration takes a strange turn when she accidentally unleashes incredible strength. As Emil plots revenge, Terra becomes the target of a brutal ambush. Meanwhile, Flamarra tracks down Adamus, only to be rejected and forced to fight her own cousin.

videos.title: The Threat Against Terra
videos.overview: Terra’s powers grow as she teleports away from danger and heals from a gunshot wound. While Emil’s men escalate their attacks, Terra finds strength in her adoptive family’s love and in the mysterious abilities she has gained. Meanwhile, Pirena desperately seeks a way back to her daughter, unaware that fate is already stirring in both worlds.

videos.title: Inherent Power
videos.overview: Terra defends her family against armed attackers, revealing strength and powers that baffle even her enemies. As Javier fights for his life, Terra finds herself at the center of an escalating war she doesn’t fully understand. Meanwhile, in Encantadia, Adamus regains his stolen memories.

videos.title: Gov. Emil's Oppression
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the attack, Terra's family struggles with injustice as powerful enemies twist the truth to their advantage. While Javier recovers in the hospital, new accusations threaten to tear their family apart. As Terra's powers surge with her growing anger, she finds herself on the brink of a perilous decision.

videos.title: Wrath of Terra
videos.overview: Terra wrestles with helplessness as Javier is unjustly arrested. Meanwhile, Mitena gives the Mine-a-ves a dangerous advantage by lifting the language barrier. As the prophecy stirs and allies move into place, Terra's rage begins to shake the earth itself.

videos.title: Persuading the Face of the Rivulet
videos.overview: Terra takes justice into her own hands and uncovers the truth behind her grandfather’s arrest. As Terra’s powers draw more attention at school, Cami begins to suspect something supernatural. Meanwhile, a dangerous robbery unfolds at the bank just as Terra, Dina, and Akiro arrive.

videos.title: Resentment of Flamarra
videos.overview: Terra steps out of the shadows to stop a violent bank robbery. In Encantadia, the Adamyans earn the Rivulet's silence with great sacrifice, while Mitena inches closer to discovering her destined adversary. As Flamarra denies her legacy, enemies close in, and Pirena finally returns to a realm now ruled by fear.

videos.title: Upon Pirena's Homecoming
videos.overview: Pirena reunites with her daughter, Flamarra. As old allies regroup and tensions rise, the search for Terra becomes more urgent than ever. Meanwhile, Mitena captures key rebels and asserts her dominance with the terrifying use of the four elemental gems.

videos.title: The Mother and Daughter Sang'gres
videos.overview: Mitena tightens her grip over her captives as the twin moons rise. In Adamya, desperate choices are made to protect Pirena from herself. Meanwhile, Flamarra faces an uncertain fate, as Mitena asserts her claim as the new power in Encantadia.

videos.title: Seizure and Suffering
videos.overview: While Mitena vents her fury on Flamarra, Pirena struggles with doubt and the burden of finding Terra in the human world. As Terra embraces her powers and saves lives once more, dark forces close in with plans to capture her. The path of destiny begins to shine brighter just as danger starts to follow.

videos.title: Hidden Powers
videos.overview: As Terra’s heroic deeds draw public attention, she begins to see the risks of being recognized. While Pirena fumbles through human technology in search of her niece, Terra receives a cryptic warning from a Kapre about a looming battle. With secrets mounting and danger closing in, Terra must decide whether being a hero is worth the price.

videos.title: New Heroine
videos.overview: Terra visits Javier with questions about a Kapre. As Adamus and Flamarra grow bolder behind enemy lines, Deia walks a fine line between loyalty and defiance. With enemies tightening their grip and identities at risk, the Sang’gres face tough choices that test their courage and trust.

videos.title: Ordeal of the Protectors
videos.overview: Terra responds to a mysterious call for help. In the arena, Adamus fights for survival as new rules stack the odds against him. And in the unseen world beyond, ancient souls stir once more, still tethered to a realm they cannot yet leave behind.

videos.title: Tales from Devas
videos.overview: In Devas, Amihan learns that fate demands sacrifices and that not every life can be spared. As the past and present intertwine, long-lost souls confront their regrets and the choices that shaped Encantadia’s destiny. Meanwhile, love, loss, and duty weigh heavily on those left behind in the mortal realm.

videos.title: Ivtres that Cannot Rest
videos.overview: In Devas, Amihan and Ybrahim struggle with grief as they reunite with their fallen daughters. While Emre insists that destiny must run its course, their pleas to return and fight for Encantadia fall on silence. Meanwhile, Flamarra and Adamus find brief solace in their reunion, as Terra faces new dangers in the mortal world with enemies closing in.

videos.title: The Search for Sang'gre Danaya's Daughter
videos.overview: Emil receives a warning from his master’s messenger. In Lireo, Deia shows kindness to Adamus as Mitena schemes her next move. Meanwhile, Pirena searches for Terra in the human world, where the Kapre finally reveals Terra’s true Diwata lineage.

videos.title: Secrets that Came to Light
videos.overview: Terra confronts her adoptive mother about the truth of her origins. As Pirena draws closer to finding her, Terra makes a choice that could change her path forever. Meanwhile, Akiro faces a family crisis that tests his loyalty and resolve.

videos.title: The Approaching Meeting
videos.overview: Terra struggles with questions about her true family while her powers lead her into danger once again. Pirena draws nearer, determined to reach her. Meanwhile, in Encantadia, Adamus is forced into a brutal test that may cost him dearly.

videos.title: Rivulet of Lies
videos.overview: Terra pushes her powers further in a daring rescue that leaves onlookers stunned, while Pirena grows more desperate to reach her. In Encantadia, a clash inside Lireo forces secrets to surface, shaking Mitena’s hold on power. Loyalties are tested on both sides as fate draws Terra and Pirena closer.

videos.title: The Kera's Unease
videos.overview: Terra grapples with her identity while saving another in need. In Encantadia, Mitena’s relentless search for truth sparks rebellion and endangers kingdoms. Secrets and prophecy edge Terra closer to her destiny.

videos.title: The Twin Spirits of the Gems
videos.overview: Emil schemes to ruin Sang’gre’s name with an impostor, while Terra vows to protect her identity. In Encantadia, Mitena learns that a Sang’gre from the human world is fated to defeat her.

videos.title: Gateway Leading to Terra
videos.overview: With the help of Agua, the twin spirit of the water gem, Mitena discovers the gateway to the mortal world.

videos.title: An Ovlar Versus a Sang'gre
videos.overview: Olgana sets out to find the destined savior in the mortal world. Will she succeed, knowing that Terra’s life lies in Pirena’s hands?

videos.title: Ashti and Hadiya
videos.overview: Terra finally comes face-to-face with her aunt, Pirena, who leaves her stunned with a surprising revelation.

videos.title: Freedom for the Encantados
videos.overview: The captive Sang’gres seize the chance to escape from the cruel Kera of Encantadia. Will Flamarra and Adamus succeed in their plan?

videos.title: Meeting at the Hiraya
videos.overview: Mitena showed her fury when she punished Mashna Mayca and her son. Meanwhile, Danaya and her daughter, Terra, cross paths once more through a dream.

videos.title: The Escape of the Two Sang'gres
videos.overview: Flamarra and Adamus attempt a daring escape from Mitena’s grasp. But will they succeed?

videos.title: Peril in District Six
videos.overview: Terra once again faces danger when Olgana and her Mine-a-ve warriors launch an attack on District Six. Will she be able to defeat the arrogant amazons?

videos.title: The Savior of District Six
videos.overview: Pirena once again comes face-to-face with Olgana, but this time, she is determined to reclaim the Fire Gem once and for all.

videos.title: The Failure of Terra
videos.overview: Terra fails to save a lot of civilians, including Akiro’s mother, who passed away from the fight against Mitena’s goons, resulting in a lot of commotion over whether to trust her or not.

videos.title: Sang’gre and Terra, One and the Same
videos.overview: After failing to save the citizens, Terra’s reputation as their hero lies in ruins. She tries to make amends, but their anger remains. Is it time for Terra to leave them behind?

videos.title: Those Failed by the Sang’gre
videos.overview: The people have lost their trust in Sang’gre, leaving her in despair. Meanwhile, Gov. Emil places a bounty on her.

videos.title: Save Us, Sang'gre
videos.overview: Despite the criticism and loss of trust in Sang’gre, she still chooses to save the people trapped inside the burning hospital.

videos.title: Restoration of Trust
videos.overview: Terra discovers that Emil is the person responsible for the fire at the hospital, triggering her grudge and prompting her desire to make him pay.

videos.title: The Ace of Gov
videos.overview: Gov. Emil plays his hidden card in an attempt to bring Terra down. How will the Sang’gre defend herself against the schemes of a greedy politician?

videos.title: Cunning Against Cunning
videos.overview: Gov. Emil grabs Terra by the neck. How will the Sang’gre escape the greed of the ruthless governor?

videos.title: The Cleansing of District Six
videos.overview: In Terra’s final battle against the cunning governor, she will expose all the corruption and wrongdoings of his term. Will District Six still have a chance to rise again?

videos.title: Farewell, District Six
videos.overview: The destined time has come for Pirena to journey with her hadiya, Terra, to Encantadia.

videos.title: Avisala, Sang'gre Terra
videos.overview: Terra is in awe upon meeting a few population of Adamya—and one of them is Imaw, who is grateful for her arrival in Encantadia.

videos.title: Pirena and Mitena
videos.overview: Will Pirena’s blazing fire prevail against Mitena’s chilling power, especially since the latter holds three gems and the mystical Esperanto?

videos.title: The Arrival of Pirena and Terra in Asilades
videos.overview: Terra, Flamarra, and Adamus finally meet for the first time as Terra warns her albes of the looming danger that Pirena is trying to prevent.

videos.title: Fire, Water and Earth
videos.overview: Deia’s anger toward their Kera Mitena intensifies after she closes the portal to the human world. Will her mother, Olgana, still be able to return to Encantadia?

videos.title: The Pure Heart of a Mine-a-ve
videos.overview: In her desire to see her mother again, Deia attempts to seize Mitena’s scepter with the help of Zaur.

videos.title: The Sigils of the Gems
videos.overview: Deia arrives in Asilades, where Flamarra, Adamus, and Terra are hiding. There, the destined new guardians of the gems will finally be revealed.

videos.title: The Fourth Keeper
videos.overview: The Sang’gres feel intense resentment toward Deia after learning that the Air Gem chose her as its guardian.

videos.title: The Treachery Against the Kera
videos.overview: The day of Zaur’s betrayal against Mitena has come. Will the Kera be able to stop the dark scheme of her once-loyal warrior?

videos.title: The Cataclysm in Encantadia
videos.overview: Deia will attempt to find a portal to reach her mother. Meanwhile, the twin spirits will face the wrath of the greedy Zaur.

videos.title: The New Harum
videos.overview: The former kera and the chosen one are missing, and a new ruler is about to lead Encantadia. But where are Terra and Mitena?

videos.title: The Encounter
videos.overview: Both Terra and Mitena will go missing in the forest. When they meet, will the two become friends?

videos.title: Care of a Sang'gre
videos.overview: Even if Mitena’s heart is as hard as ice, Terra still seems to have melted it. What will be the outcome of the first meeting between the two powerful Sang’gres?

videos.title: The Growing Bond of Naya and Samina
videos.overview: As Naya and Samina grow closer, the conflict between Flamarra and Deia deepens.

videos.title: Terra and Mitena
videos.overview: The new Sang’gres will face the fury of Zaur’s greed. Will they stand a chance against the new harum now that he holds the powerful scepter?

videos.title: Upon the Descent of Darkness
videos.overview: After the balance of Encantadia is broken due to the demise of the twin spirits, the Sang’gres will journey to Devas to speak with the deity Emre.

videos.title: Devas and Ec'naad
videos.overview: Pirena and the four young guardians journey to Devas in search of Emre’s guidance, but before reaching him, they must first overcome the trials set by Ec'naad, the formidable chief guardian of Devas’ gates.

videos.title: The Sang'gres in Devas
videos.overview: Pirena couldn’t hold back her emotions upon seeing her departed sister, Amihan, once again in Devas.

videos.title: The Ferocity of the Elements
videos.overview: Terra, Adamus, Flamarra, and Deia will now face the ancient Twin Spirits.

videos.title: Air and Fire
videos.overview: Terra and Adamus will begin to command the twin spirits of earth and water, while Deia and Flamarra will face the fierce twin spirits of air and fire.

videos.title: End of Trials
videos.overview: All the new Sang’gres succeed in the trial of the twin spirits, and the gems of Fire, Air, Water, and Earth are finally bestowed upon them.

videos.title: Union and Farewell
videos.overview: Pirena got emotional after reuniting with her departed loved ones. Meanwhile, Mitena will have a chance to meet the new lady who will help her recover the secret weapon she will use against Zaur.

videos.title: The Essence of a Kera
videos.overview: Mitena will use Ayeshka’s beauty and likeness to fight against Zaur.

videos.title: Duel Between the Kera and the Harum
videos.overview: Zaur will once again capture Mitena after she attempts to take his life.

videos.title: Those Who Return
videos.overview: Now that the new Sang’gres hold the gems, they will restore balance to Encantadia once more.

videos.title: Training of the New Guardians
videos.overview: Using the gems, the Sang’gres will gain weapons they can wield in battle.

videos.title: The New Armors
videos.overview: The Sang’gres are now ready to face the battle ahead, and they are determined to reclaim and save Encantadia from Mitena.

videos.title: The Reclaiming of Hathoria
videos.overview: Using the gems, the Sang’gres will storm Pirena’s kingdom to reclaim it from the vile feznaks who have taken control.

videos.title: For Adamya
videos.overview: After reclaiming the kingdom of Hathoria, the Sang’gres will next set out to take back the kingdom of Adamya.

videos.title: The Kera and the Chosen
videos.overview: Terra and Mitena, once friends, will face each other again. What will be the outcome of their reunion?

videos.title: War Within and Beyond
videos.overview: After their battle with Mitena, the Sang’gres grow anxious about what may come next. Will their hearts and purpose remain united for the Encantadia they hold dear?

videos.title: Doubt or Trust
videos.overview: Terra believes that Mitena might change her ways, which can help them restore the balance and peace in Encantadia.

videos.title: The Extinguishing of Fire
videos.overview: Pirena will once again face Olgana to protect Encantadia, but a bitter fate seems to await the queen of Hathoria.

videos.title: Avisala Meiste, Hara Pirena
videos.overview: With the loss of Hara Pirena, anger will ignite throughout Encantadia.

videos.title: Surge of Fire
videos.overview: With the loss of Hara Pirena, rage burns even stronger in Sang’gre Flamarra’s heart — but vengeance comes at a price. What could it be?

videos.title: Pure Love
videos.overview: The rivulet of truth will reveal a meaningful answer to the new Sang’gres. Meanwhile, Pirena will attempt to escape from Devas to return once more to Encantadia.

videos.title: The Sang’gres in Mine-a-ve
videos.overview: Deia, Adamus, and Terra will try to search for the Sang’gres captured by Mitena in Mine-a-ve.

videos.title: A New Ally
videos.overview: After escaping from Devas, Pirena and Gaiea will face the danger brought by the Gulmoroks, but a mysterious man will come to save their lives.

videos.title: Escape of the Sang’gres
videos.overview: Aside from Pirena and Gaiea, the inseparable albe duo Mira and Lira will also escape from Devas.

videos.title: The Trial of Sang’gre Danaya
videos.overview: While Danaya believes that Mitena is about to set her free, little does she know that the queen plans to use her as bait for her daughter, Terra.

videos.title: The Battle of Flamarra
videos.overview: As Flamarra storms Lireo to defeat Mitena, the fire of her emotions burns even stronger. Will she succeed in avenging her mother?

videos.title: A Mother’s Lament
videos.overview: Terra and the other Sang’gres arrive marching at Lireo to confront and take down Mitena and her army.

videos.title: Power of the Black Stone
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to Pirena, her father, Hagorn, is the current lord ruling over the dreaded Balaak.

videos.title: Danaya and Her Children
videos.overview: Through the power of the black stone, Mitena will finally be able to bend Danaya to her will. Will the false queen succeed in her schemes?

videos.title: Mother Against Daughter
videos.overview: Will Danaya be able to carry out her plan to kill her own daughter, Terra?

videos.title: The Wind’s Whisper
videos.overview: After falling into the hands of the Ovlars, Deia discovers a secret from her own kin. What could it be?

videos.title: The Captive Sang'gres
videos.overview: Using their gems, Terra, Adamus, Flamarra, and Deia will join forces to free Danaya from the power of the black stone. Meanwhile, a new threat looms over Encantadia.

videos.title: Terra and Gaiea
videos.overview: In an unexpected turn of events, Terra saves Gaiea, who, unbeknownst to her, is her older sister. What will be the outcome of their first meeting?

videos.title: Mitena in the Human World
videos.overview: Mitena will invade the mortal world to search for Nanay Mona and Lolo Javier. Meanwhile, will Pirena accept Hagorn’s offer?

videos.title: The Family of Terra
videos.overview: Terra, Deia, Adamus, and Flamarra arrive in the mortal world to rescue Mona and Javier from Mitena’s grasp. Will they succeed in their mission?

videos.title: The Liberation of the Sang’gres
videos.overview: Danaya, Alena, Cassiopea, and Armea will aid the new Sang’gres in their battle against Mitena. Meanwhile, will Terra be able to save Lolo Javier?

videos.title: True Strength
videos.overview: Agnem imprisoned Mira and Lira in another attempt to unite with them.

videos.title: The Dark Terra
videos.overview: Terra hears a whisper from Esperanto that fuels her anger and drives her to desire Mitena’s downfall. Will she be able to resist the darkness slowly taking hold of her?

videos.title: Clinging to the Light
videos.overview: The Sang’gres now hold Daron’s fate in their hands. What judgment will they give the Mine-a-ve warrior?

videos.title: Clash of the Twin Spirits
videos.overview: Cassiopea confronts Zaur, while the Sang’gres continue their battle against the Hadezar Twin Spirits.

videos.title: The Black Gem
videos.overview: After Emre’s death, the king of darkness, Gargan, rises once more.

videos.title: The New Fate of Cassiopea
videos.overview: Cassiopea is shocked to learn that they have a new enemy to face, Gargan, who possesses the black gem.

videos.title: The Hara of Lireo
videos.overview: With the loss of the deity Emre, Cassiopeia will take his place as the guide of all Encantadia and as the goddess who will lead Devas.

videos.title: The Grief of Gaiea
videos.overview: Alena is given the chance to exact revenge on the Mitena she deeply despises. But will she truly be able to kill her own blood?

videos.title: Danaya and the Bitter Truth
videos.overview: Danaya seethes with fury after discovering the betrayal of everyone she once trusted in Encantadia.

videos.title: Paopao and the Soul Gem
videos.overview: Danaya confronts Cassiopeia to demand answers from the goddess for all the lies she kept from her.

videos.title: The Unleashing of Dread
videos.overview: The Sang’gres will confront Gargan’s spreading darkness in the world of humans. Meanwhile, will Hagorn finally be able to break free from the Balaak?

videos.title: The Third Eye of Mitena
videos.overview: Mitena has a vision about the arrival of Gargan in Encantadia. Will Hara Alena and the other Encantados believe her?

videos.title: The Sealing of Balaak
videos.overview: Mira will make Hagorn pay for destroying the ivtre of her mother, Pirena.

videos.title: The Duel of Danaya and Pirena
videos.overview: Cami and Gargan continue with their wicked plans, while the Sang’gres struggle to understand the tools of the mortal world.

videos.title: Terra’s Shifting Forms
videos.overview: Terra and Gargan are finally set to meet! Meanwhile, the council advises Queen Armea that Sapiro now needs a new rama to lead the entire kingdom.

videos.title: The Beloatheds
videos.overview: The sisters, Lira and Armea, will reunite. Meanwhile, Terra is finally ready to tell Deia that Olgana is still alive.

videos.title: The Fate of the Hara of Sapiro
videos.overview: The Sang’gres will receive a warning! Will they be able to protect both worlds against the lord of darkness?

videos.title: The Battle of Gargan and the Sang'gres
videos.overview: Worry is written on Alena’s face as she recalls Mitena’s vision. Meanwhile, the Sang’gres are finally set to confront Gargan in the mortal world.

videos.title: The Grief of Terra
videos.overview: Hagorn will attempt to negotiate with Mitena. Meanwhile, Terra is determined to make Gargan pay for Nanay Mona’s death.

videos.title: Terra’s Promise
videos.overview: There is no trace of mercy in Terra’s eyes as she confronts Cami to make her answer for her mother’s death.

videos.title: The Clash of the New Goddess and the Dark God
videos.overview: The new goddess Cassiopeia and the dark god Gargan are about to clash.

videos.title: The Sang’gres in an Unfamiliar World
videos.overview: Will Mitena be able to prove her loyalty to Alena? Meanwhile, how long will Hagorn continue to hide under Pirena’s identity?

videos.title: Terra, Gaiea, and Danaya
videos.overview: Terra cannot believe that her mother, Danaya, and her sister Gaiea are now in the mortal world.

videos.title: The Wrath of a Curse
videos.overview: Mitena endures her imprisonment, igniting the return of the anger buried deep within her heart. Will she abandon goodness and once again unleash terror upon Encantadia?

videos.title: The Return of Mitena’s Rage
videos.overview: Hagorn and Alena face each other once more after a long time apart. Who will emerge victorious in their long-awaited confrontation?

videos.title: The Song of Lira
videos.overview: Tension runs high among the Sang’gres as each faces their own trials. Meanwhile, the new Sang’gres prepare to confront Gargan, the God of Darkness.

videos.title: The Code and Combat of the Sang’gres
videos.overview: As the Sang’gres confront Gargan, they bear witness to the true ferocity of his power.

videos.title: The Deceitful Temptation
videos.overview: Gargan holds Terra’s friend, Dina, captive. Will Terra be able to save her?

videos.title: Alena’s Decision
videos.overview: Amid Armea’s fierce opposition to a forced marriage to Soldarius, she decides to surrender her throne as queen and flee the kingdom of Sapiro.

videos.title: The Fruit of Freedom
videos.overview: After leaving the throne of Sapiro as queen and escaping her marriage, Armea finally attains the freedom she has long desired, but what fate awaits her next?

videos.title: Lord of Balaak in Encantadia
videos.overview: Mitena agrees to Hagorn’s request to help free his soldiers in Balaak.

videos.title: Hagorn’s Return to Balaak
videos.overview: To carry out his plan to reopen Balaak, Hagorn relies on his sharp mind. Will he succeed?

videos.title: False or True Pirena
videos.overview: How did Pirena come back to life when Hagorn had already ended the ivtre of the brave Sang’gre? Will her sister and daughter believe that she is real and not merely a false creation of Hagorn?

videos.title: Deia’s Abandonment of Her Roots
videos.overview: Amid the battle between good and darkness, Adamus wrestles with whether he should finally confess his true feelings to Deia.

videos.title: New Chaos in the Human World
videos.overview: The human world is engulfed in fear as forces of darkness launch their attack. How will the Sang’gres stop this growing threat?

videos.title: The God in Disguise
videos.overview: Gargan shifts his form to deceive the Sang’gres and exploit their weaknesses.

videos.title: Armea’s Defense of a Former Enemy
videos.overview: On the day of Armea’s wedding, chaos erupts when she asks the council to grant freedom to the captive Mine-a-ves.

videos.title: The Union of Armea and Soldarius
videos.overview: Though the union of Soldarius and Armea is against their will, they have no choice but to go through with it for the sake of the kingdom of Sapiro.

videos.title: The Deception on Deia
videos.overview: Deia has completely fallen under Gargan’s power. How will she face her fellow Sang’gres now that she has become a traitor among them?

videos.title: Seeking Help from the Twin Spirits
videos.overview: Pirena proves that her sharp mind has never faded as she outwits Hagorn using her shape-shifting ability, leading him to believe that her ivtre has already perished.

videos.title: The Cost of a Promise
videos.overview: The Sang’gres face trials brought forth by Gargan. Will they be able to overcome his challenge?

videos.title: The Pure Hearts of the Sang’gres
videos.overview: After defeating the lure of darkness, the Sang’gres return stronger, with clearer minds and purer hearts.

videos.title: The True Meaning
videos.overview: Anger still lingers in Danaya’s heart toward her apwe, Pirena, because of the betrayal committed against her in the past.

videos.title: The Sorrow of Danaya
videos.overview: Unknown to all, Mitena’s alliance with darkness is itself an act of betrayal, as she secretly aids the Sang’gres.

videos.title: The Unmasking of Deceit
videos.overview: With Daron’s help, Sapiro gains a chance to outwit those attempting to invade their kingdom.

videos.title: The Suspected Betrayal of Mitena
videos.overview: Hagorn investigates who helped Sapiro evade their planned invasion, with Mitena emerging as one of his prime suspects.

videos.title: The Sang’gre in the Hands of Gargan
videos.overview: Terra’s life is put in danger after Gargan reveals his true form. Will the Sang’gre survive his deadly power?

videos.title: The Real Motive of Gargan
videos.overview: In an unexpected encounter, Lira comes face to face once more with the Mine-a-ve who ended her life, the reason she is now an ivtre.

videos.title: The Resurrection of Gaiea
videos.overview: Gargan grants Gaiea her wish to live once more, but what price must be paid in return?

videos.title: The Source of Life
videos.overview: Gaiea cannot reveal to her sibling and the Sang’gres who granted her a new body and life.

videos.title: The Truth Behind Gargan’s Gift
videos.overview: The Sang’gre discover that the gifted body given to Gaiea came from Gargan, and she refuses to give it back.

videos.title: The Sang’gres' Battle in a Strange World
videos.overview: Believing they are strongest when together, Gargan decides to separate the Sang’gres so he can quickly seize the gems from them.

videos.title: The Sang’gres' Prayer
videos.overview: Hagorn’s allies, Mitena and Agane, clash in a decisive confrontation. What lies at the heart of their conflict, and who will emerge victorious between the two?

videos.title: Gaiea's Return to Being an Ivtre
videos.overview: Gargan’s conquest of Encantadia draws near. Will the Sang’gre be able to stop the fury of a Bathala?

videos.title: The Homecoming of Flamarra and Gaiea
videos.overview: With the return of the albes Gaiea and Flamarra to the world of Encantadia, Flamarra longs to see once more the one her heart holds dear: Soldarius.

videos.title: The Dark Premonition of Mitena
videos.overview: Flammara and Soldarius are reunited at last, and the diwata learns of his new role in Sapiro.

videos.title: The Waning Flame of Flamarra’s Heart
videos.overview: As an Encantada and Sang’gre, courage is expected of Flamarra, leaving no room for weakness of the heart. Yet she cannot understand why she is deeply hurt upon learning that Soldarius has married her albe, Armea.

videos.title: The Promise of Rebirth
videos.overview: While Pirena is in Devas, Cassiopea grants the Sang’gre a chance to live again so she may fulfill her mission.

videos.title: An Opportunity for a Second Life
videos.overview: To carry out their plan against Gargan, the Sang’gres will need the help of their twin spirits.

videos.title: The Demand for the Earth Gem’s Surrender
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to Terra, Mitena foresees a troubling vision involving her. What could this ominous sign be?

videos.title: The Fate of the Children of Danaya
videos.overview: Terra faces Gargan alone once more in a final attempt to defeat him for good.

videos.title: Prayer and Sorrow
videos.overview: The Sang’gre are left in shock when Terra’s lifeless body is returned to them. How will they defeat the lord of darkness now?

videos.title: The Return of Terra to Encantadia
videos.overview: After Terra’s death, the Sang’gre are left wondering why the retre did not fetch her ivtre to bring it to Devas.

videos.title: Danaya’s Mourning
videos.overview: All of Encantadia mourns the death of Sang’gre Terra. How will Danaya accept the passing of her youngest child?

videos.title: The Slaying of Armea
videos.overview: To avenge and finally slay Gargan, Danaya will need the help of her sisters, Alena and Pirena, as well as her departed sister, Amihan.

videos.title: Danaya and Pirena’s Agreement
videos.overview: Someone is attempting to take Armea’s life, and she will not stop until she discovers who ordered it.

videos.title: Flamarra’s Confrontation with Gargan
videos.overview: After Terra’s death, the Sang’gre seek vengeance against Gargan. But how can they avenge the diwata when Flamarra’s life is now in danger in the hands of the lord of darkness?

videos.title: The Harnessing of Mitena’s Power
videos.overview: As the siblings prepare their plan to invade the human world and slay Gargan, Amihan returns to the kingdom of Lireo.

videos.title: The Reunion of the Sang’gre of Old
videos.overview: Will the Sang’gres be able to defeat their greatest enemy, Gargan, once they combine their forces?

videos.title: The Scepter of Gargan
videos.overview: Terra is stunned to come face to face with her own form consumed by dark intent. What could this sinister double want from her?

videos.title: The Fight Against Oneself
videos.overview: Deia is trapped in a decision she must make—save her traitorous mother or do what is right for the sake of the world and Encantadia.

videos.title: The Asvor in the Hands of Mitena
videos.overview: Mitena is astonished to find that she can command Gargan’s powerful scepter. Will she use it for evil or for good?

videos.title: The Traitor of Sapiro
videos.overview: The Sang’gres prepare to face their greatest enemy yet. How can they defeat the Bathala of Darkness, Gargan, if they do not know the full extent of his power?

videos.title: The Clash Between the Former Sang’gres and Gargan
videos.overview: The Sang’gres finally face Gargan in battle. What is the most powerful weapon the diwanis can use against the mightiest of the Bathalas?

videos.title: The Dark Scheme Against the Hara of Sapiro
videos.overview: As two moons rise in the sky, Pirena’s new power, stronger and more ferocious than before, is destined to emerge.

videos.title: Halting the Battle for Terra
videos.overview: All the Sang’gres unite their forces to destroy Gargan’s black diamond. Will they finally defeat the dark Bathala and save Terra?

videos.title: Threat and Doubt
videos.overview: Although Terra is truly Gargan’s captive, the Sang’gres refuse to believe the Bathala and suspect that he is merely deceiving them, something that deeply worries Danaya.

videos.title: Danaya in Disguise
videos.overview: The powers of the Sang’gres, Pirena and Mitena, grow even stronger. How will they use this newfound strength?

videos.title: Submit to Fate or Shape Your Own Destiny
videos.overview: Through wit and strength in battle, the Sang’gre manage to seize Gargan’s black gem. But unknown to them, it is shrouded in powerful magic.

videos.title: The Threat to the Sang’gres and Humankind
videos.overview: After countless battles, will the Sang’gre finally triumph against the destructive power of the Dark Bathala?

videos.title: The Sang’gres in the Midst of the Storm
videos.overview: As the Sang’gres return to Encantadia, they also bring with them the black diamond in which Terra is imprisoned.

videos.title: The Fate of Terra’s Ivtre
videos.overview: To save Terra, the Sang’gres must travel to Balaak for a mission in Salveo. What could this mission be?

videos.title: The Special  Test for Terra
videos.overview: Before the powerful sage Memen helps the Sang’gres, they must first overcome the trial he has prepared for them.

videos.title: Refusing to Surrender for Terra
videos.overview: After obtaining the answer they sought from the sage, the Sang’gres immediately return to Lireo to perform the ritual that will return Terra’s ivtre to her body.

videos.title: Awakening in the Midst of New Peril
videos.overview: Terra’s resurrection becomes the signal for the beginning of a new war against Gargan and the forces of darkness.

videos.title: The Reunion of Terra and Mitena
videos.overview: All the Sang’gres unite their forces in an attempt to destroy the black gem and finally defeat Gargan.

videos.title: The Desire for the Black Gem
videos.overview: Upon returning to Encantadia, Gargan first confronts Mitena to reclaim his powerful scepter.

videos.title: The Unexpected Ally
videos.overview: Hagorn uncovers the double-crossing nature of Mitena, whom he once believed to be his ally.

videos.title: Farewell, Hagorn
videos.overview: With Flamarra’s return to Encantadia, she once again sees Soldarius, the one she secretly holds dear. How long can she keep her feelings hidden for the Rama of Sapiro, who is married to her albe?

videos.title: The Return of Balintataw to Imaw
videos.overview: Terra will once again leave her body to become an ivtre and enter Devas alongside Lira and Gaiea.

videos.title: Bathala Gargan and Bathaluman Ether
videos.overview: Terra, Gaiea, and Lira continue their journey to the mysterious purgatory known as Dalum Deva.

videos.title: The New Trial of Ether
videos.overview: Using the gems, the Sang’gres attempt to grant protection to all of Encantadia against the destructive power of Gargan.

videos.title: The Lament of Mitena
videos.overview: After learning of the looming danger to himself, Adamus decides to visit his apwe Armea to deliver a final message.

videos.title: A Father’s Wish
videos.overview: From Balaak, Memen travels to Encantadia to see his daughter Mitena. What favor will he ask from the diwatas?

videos.title: The Etherian Father and Daughter
videos.overview: Gargan will use the loyal lambana Rikit as a spy within Encantadia.

videos.title: The Song of War
videos.overview: Mitena discovers Memen’s secrets, believing that her father has betrayed her once again.

videos.title: Adamus’ Great Battle for Adamya
videos.overview: Will Mitena’s horrifying vision about Adamus finally come to pass?

videos.title: The Forced Surrender of the Water Gem
videos.overview: Adamus suffers greatly at the hands of Zaur in order to take his gemstone. Can Deia save him before the enemy finally ends his life?
